The '''Skirmish on Bespin''' was a conflict between [[Trioculus' Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Zorba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]].

==Prelude==
After his release from prison, [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he discovered the death of his son [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]. After have recovered Jabba's testament in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], he came to the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and regained control of the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino|Holiday Towers]] from [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. By tricking him at [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], he managed to become the new [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the city.

Soon later [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was captured in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Factory barge (Bespin)|factory barge]] over the [[Rethin Sea]] and [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|Jedi Prince]] [[Ken]] was arrested by [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]], now working for Zorba. Zorba the Hutt planned to exchange Ken to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Trioculus]] for Leia Organa, the murderer of his son. On the other hand, Trioculus intented to make Leia his empress.

==The battle==
Although he was in search for Ken, Trioculus refused to hand over Leia when Zorba made his proposal. In response, he called [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in to take out Zorba, but the Cloud Police emerge on Zorba's side. All stormtroopers were eliminated and Trioculus was captured while fleeing.

Meanwhile, Ken had escape from holding in the casino with the help of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], returning to [[Han Solo's sky house]]. On the barge, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] found Leia and the duo were rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. They were just living the barge when it was destroyed by a fleet of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] ships led by the ''[[Zorba Express]]''.

==Aftermath==
As the rebels reunited and left Bespin, Zorba Desilijic Tiure encased the would-be Imperial leader in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], intending on using the captive Imperial's presence as a hostage as a means of protecting Cloud City from Imperial threat. As for Leia Organa, he believed she was killed on the barge and that revenge has been served.
